name: reference-platform-advantage-registry
purpose: Tracks public desktop, AI IDE, agent engine, and native operator app references and records which product-strength patterns should be transferred into the installable agent workspace platform.

reader_guide.summary: Use this registry to connect researched reference-platform strengths to concrete desktop-app product patterns, implementation targets, and safety boundaries.
how_to_read: Read source_boundary first to understand which public sources are allowed and which copied assets are excluded.
Read reference_links as the evidence handle list; each item has the same planning use so source ids can be traced from transfer_patterns.
Read platform_groups to understand the reference categories and their role in this product.
Read transfer_patterns as the actual product backlog and contract transfer list.
update_triggers: A new reference app, agent CLI, IDE, or native operator tool is used to justify product behavior.
A transfer pattern changes status, priority, implementation target, or risk control.
A source becomes unavailable, clone-disabled, license-unclear, or contradicted by a stronger source.
Customer snapshot or product navigation changes rely on this reference map.
reader_guide.product_rule: 모니터링은 운영자 보조면이고, 사용자가 팔 수 있는 가치로 보는 첫 화면은 에이전트 오케스트레이션, 작업 환경, 개발 환경, 에이전트 생성, 학습 개선 루프다.

reference_links.title: Visual Studio Code user interface
reference_links.limitation: UI structure is documented, not a direct product strategy document.
reference_links.plan_impact: Use one activity rail, a focused side bar, an editor center, and a bottom panel for terminal/output.

reference_links.title: IntelliJ Platform UI overview
reference_links.limitation: Plugin SDK docs describe default workbench areas rather than AI workflows.
reference_links.plan_impact: Use tool windows around the editor and avoid duplicate sidebars that compete for navigation.

reference_links.title: IntelliJ IDEA tool windows
reference_links.limitation: Tool-window documentation is IDE-general and must be translated into agent run semantics.
reference_links.plan_impact: Put Run Configuration, Services, Problems, and status context at the top of the Desktop Runtime surface so execution, setup gaps, and blockers are visible before long panels.

reference_links.title: GitHub Copilot cloud agent
reference_links.limitation: Cloud GitHub-centered flow differs from local desktop ownership.
reference_links.plan_impact: Model task intake as research, plan, branch/workspace changes, validation, diff review, and PR/commit handoff.

reference_links.title: GitHub Copilot cloud agent risks and mitigations
reference_links.limitation: GitHub-specific controls need local equivalents.
reference_links.plan_impact: Keep tool access, untrusted input, automation approval, and workflow approval visible in the platform.

reference_links.title: Claude Code overview
reference_links.limitation: Product claims should be translated into platform-neutral patterns.
reference_links.plan_impact: Support terminal, desktop, IDE-like diff review, multiple sessions, scheduled tasks, MCP, hooks, skills, and agent teams as replaceable capability lanes.

reference_links.title: Claude Code custom subagents
reference_links.limitation: Subagent details are Claude-specific.
reference_links.plan_impact: Agent Factory must create specialized workers with separate context, explicit tools, permissions, memory, and resume behavior.

reference_links.title: Claude Code hooks
reference_links.limitation: Hook event names differ across tools.
reference_links.plan_impact: Add platform-level pre-tool, permission, post-tool, failure, stop, and elicitation gates.

reference_links.title: Claude Code MCP
reference_links.limitation: MCP examples are Claude-specific but the protocol and trust concerns generalize.
reference_links.plan_impact: Surface MCP servers as scoped tool connectors with trust review, auth state, resource references, and elicitation dialogs.

reference_links.title: OpenHands key features
reference_links.limitation: OpenHands is a full agent system, not only a desktop shell.
reference_links.plan_impact: Expose chat, changes, embedded editor, terminal, app preview, and browser lanes as separate workbench tabs.

reference_links.title: OpenHands Software Agent SDK
reference_links.limitation: SDK adoption would need license, dependency, and sandbox review before bundling.
reference_links.plan_impact: Treat software-agent infrastructure as modular engine candidates instead of hand-rolling every future agent capability.

reference_links.title: Cline overview
reference_links.limitation: Cline is editor-extension-first.
reference_links.plan_impact: Keep every file, command, browser, and tool action visible with explicit approval and checkpoint recovery.

reference_links.title: Devin Desktop Cascade memories and rules
reference_links.limitation: Devin/Windsurf product naming changed; use pattern, not brand-specific file paths.
reference_links.plan_impact: Separate auto memories, explicit rules, manual workflows, and richer skills so users know what each setting does.

reference_links.title: Cursor agent overview
reference_links.limitation: The public page redirected during direct fetch; search cache was used for content confirmation.
reference_links.plan_impact: Use sidepane agent, diff review, chat tabs, checkpoints, terminal integration, history, and rules as feature checks.

reference_links.title: Cursor background agents
reference_links.limitation: The public page redirected during direct fetch; search cache was used for content confirmation.
reference_links.plan_impact: Use asynchronous task agents, remote/isolated machine setup, branch handoff, terminal startup commands, and takeover affordances.

reference_links.title: Continue AI pull request checks
reference_links.limitation: Current Continue docs emphasize PR checks rather than a full local workbench.
reference_links.plan_impact: Convert quality rules into markdown checks that can become validation gates and failure-to-fix suggestions.

reference_links.title: Aider documentation
reference_links.limitation: Terminal-first UX needs desktop wrapping for non-CLI users.
reference_links.plan_impact: Keep git-native local editing, repo maps, lint/test loops, and scriptability available through guest CLI lanes.

reference_links.title: OpenCode docs
reference_links.limitation: Terminal-first assumptions need native workbench controls.
reference_links.plan_impact: Use project initialization, AGENTS.md generation, @ file search, plan/build mode split, and multi-provider config patterns.

reference_links.title: Hawardshin/claw-code
used_for: Claw Code optional adapter and clean-room reference transfer planning
reference_links.limitation: Direct clone returned 403 disabled during this work, and no license file was verified. Public GitHub page plus raw README/CLAW/PARITY documents were reachable, so only architecture and product patterns are transferred.
reference_links.plan_impact: Add Claw Code as an optional CLI guest adapter and transfer slash-command orchestration, skills/MCP/runtime manifest, hook/plugin gap tracking, and parity-audit patterns without copying source.

reference_links.title: Tauri sidecar binaries
reference_links.limitation: Sidecars need platform-specific binaries and explicit capabilities.
reference_links.plan_impact: Bundle local engines as sidecars only with clear permissions, args, runtime contracts, and rollback.

reference_links.title: Tauri distribution and signing
reference_links.limitation: Public release still needs signing/notarization credentials.
reference_links.plan_impact: Keep internal test app, customer bundle, public release, signing, notarization, and updater gates distinct.

reference_links.title: OWASP LLM01 prompt injection
reference_links.limitation: Mitigations reduce risk but do not prove safety.
reference_links.plan_impact: Treat external content and connected tools as untrusted, enforce least privilege, structured validation, and human approval for high-risk actions.

reference_links.title: MCP security best practices
reference_links.limitation: MCP security guidance must be combined with local OS and credential boundaries.
reference_links.plan_impact: Use scoped MCP servers, consent boundaries, token handling, local server compromise controls, and tool search to reduce context and risk.

reference_links.title: Docker Desktop docs
reference_links.limitation: Container management differs from AI agent orchestration.
reference_links.plan_impact: Use one-click install, centralized dashboard, settings, troubleshooting, integrated terminal, extensions, notifications, and resource visibility as native-app patterns.

reference_links.title: GitHub Desktop docs
reference_links.limitation: GitHub Desktop does not solve AI orchestration itself.
reference_links.plan_impact: Use visual confirmation of changes, branch workflows, commit attribution, push/pull, clone, and PR creation as the Git workbench baseline.

reference_links.title: Raycast extensions manual
reference_links.limitation: Launcher UX is a support pattern, not the full product shell.
reference_links.plan_impact: Use command palette, extension store, tool selection, background updates, and fast keyboard-first actions for capability launch.

reference_links.title: Codex app features
used_for: Codex app desktop reference transfer planning
reference_links.limitation: Codex app features are OpenAI-specific; transfer only the desktop workbench pattern, not product identity or proprietary UI.
reference_links.plan_impact: Use thread-level workspaces, Local/Worktree/Cloud mode choices, built-in Git/diff, integrated terminal, in-app browser, artifact preview, automations, skills, MCP, and approval/sandbox controls as desktop-agent reference requirements.

reference_links.title: Codex app commands
used_for: Codex app desktop reference transfer planning
reference_links.limitation: Keyboard shortcuts and deep links must be adapted to this platform's naming and native shell.
reference_links.plan_impact: Use command menu, settings shortcut, open-folder action, sidebar/diff/terminal toggles, thread search, find-in-thread, slash commands, and deep links as a desktop interaction baseline.

reference_links.title: Codex agent skills
used_for: skill and reusable workflow packaging transfer planning
reference_links.limitation: Skill discovery and metadata should be platform-neutral and should not assume only Codex can run reusable workflows.
reference_links.plan_impact: Use progressive disclosure, explicit invocation, repository/user/admin/system scopes, plugin packaging, UI metadata, and dependency declarations for Agent Factory and capability promotion.

reference_links.title: Claude Desktop local MCP servers and desktop extensions
used_for: Claude Desktop connector and extension reference transfer planning
reference_links.limitation: MCP in Claude Desktop is documented as beta and uses Claude-specific extension packaging and settings labels.
reference_links.plan_impact: Use one-click local tool extension installation, Settings > Extensions organization, connector status from the chat composer, manifest-based packaging, sensitive config encryption, debug logs, and enterprise allowlist controls as connector UX requirements.

reference_links.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Documentation
used_for: production agent runtime, memory, gateway, identity, browser/code tools, observability, evaluation, and policy transfer planning
separating local development/execution from optional managed deployment
reference_links.limitation: AWS managed-service details are optional deployment adapters in this product, not mandatory local runtime dependencies or the default execution host.
reference_links.plan_impact: Expose AgentCore-style lifecycle and capability blueprints in the Agents surface while preserving the desktop app and local Python runtime as the primary host runtime.

reference_links.title: awslabs/agentcore-samples
used_for: AgentCore sample repository structure, quickstart lifecycle, blueprint categories, and Apache-2.0 source boundary
reference_links.limitation: Repository is sampled as a public reference; source code is not copied into the product bundle.
reference_links.plan_impact: Transfer create/local-dev/optional-deploy/invoke, add memory/identity/evaluator/gateway, blueprints, and observability/evaluation as desktop product blueprint controls.

structure_rules.rule: Each transfer pattern must name source platforms, observed strength, platform decision, current assets, implementation targets, risk controls, status, priority, and source ids.
structure_rules.reason: Reference inspiration must become a concrete product contract rather than vague imitation.

structure_rules.rule: Patterns with queued_p0 status must map to a concrete UI or runtime surface.
structure_rules.reason: High-priority product gaps should not remain abstract roadmap language.

structure_rules.rule: Customer snapshots may show summary and product value, but internal research files and local source paths must not be required for customer use.
structure_rules.reason: The installed product should not expose development repository internals as required user knowledge.

status.implemented: 이미 화면 또는 실행 흐름에 반영된 기능
status.integrated_contract: 런타임/문서/레지스트리 계약에 반영됐지만 네이티브 구현 보강이 남은 기능
status.queued_p0: 제품 완성도를 위해 다음 큰 구현 단위로 처리해야 하는 기능

priority.p0: 판매 가능한 데스크톱 플랫폼 구조에 직접 영향

field_guide.meaning: Allowed and excluded evidence boundaries for using reference platforms.
Public source handles used to ground transfer patterns.
Reference platform categories and the role each category plays in this product.
Concrete feature and architecture patterns transferred into the desktop product contract.
Allowed status and priority values for transfer pattern triage.

product_position.purpose: 레퍼런스 앱의 장점을 복사하는 것이 아니라, 에이전트 플랫폼의 핵심 작업 루프에 맞춰 재구성한다.
product_position.primary_rule: 작업 시작, 에이전트 오케스트레이션, 파일/코드 조작, 검증, 학습 개선이 첫 화면의 중심이어야 한다.
product_position.customer_promise: 사용자는 앱을 켜고 워크스페이스를 선택한 뒤 파일, 터미널, 에이전트, 검증, 히스토리를 한 데스크톱 워크벤치에서 다룬다.
product_position.monitoring_boundary: 모니터링과 운영자 기능은 상태 확인, 감사, 복구를 돕는 보조면으로 분리한다.

platform_groups.strongest_advantage: activity rail, side bar, editor center, tool windows, bottom terminal/output panel, status bar
platform_groups.transfer_rule: 우리 앱은 웹 대시보드가 아니라 단일 네이티브 워크벤치여야 하며, 중복 사이드바를 제거하고 아래 패널을 터미널/로그/검증에 배정한다.

platform_groups.strongest_advantage: chat/thread workbench, agent sidepane, diff review, background agents, rules, memories, workflows, skills, MCP connectors, checkpoints
platform_groups.transfer_rule: 에이전트가 어디서 일하는지, 어떤 권한과 규칙으로 움직이는지, 어떤 로컬 도구와 연결됐는지, 변경을 어떻게 되돌리는지를 항상 사용자가 볼 수 있어야 한다.

platform_groups.strongest_advantage: tool approval, CLI/scriptability, SDKs, PR checks, slash-command orchestration, skills/MCP surfaces, embedded editor/terminal/browser lanes
platform_groups.transfer_rule: 성숙한 오픈소스 기능은 게스트 어댑터 또는 엔진 후보로 평가하되, 플랫폼의 데이터/권한/검증 경계가 우선한다.

platform_groups.strongest_advantage: one-click setup, settings dialogs, troubleshooting, command palette, channels/spaces, visual confirmation
platform_groups.transfer_rule: 설정과 복구는 팝업/전용 패널에 두고, 반복 작업은 커맨드 팔레트와 확장 카탈로그로 빠르게 실행한다.

platform_groups.label: Production Agent Platforms
platform_groups.role_in_product: Translate mature agent production lifecycle patterns into local-first desktop surfaces without making AWS mandatory.

transfer_patterns.label_ko: 단일 사이드바 + 중앙 작업대 + 하단 터미널
transfer_patterns.label_en: Single activity rail, workbench center, bottom terminal
transfer_patterns.observed_strength: Mature desktop apps separate navigation, editor/work area, terminal/output, and status so users do not scroll through one long web page.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: Keep one primary sidebar, route feature tabs into the workbench center, and reserve the bottom drawer for multi-CLI terminal, logs, validation, and task runs.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자가 어디서 파일을 보고, 어디서 명령을 실행하고, 어디서 결과를 확인하는지 즉시 이해한다.
implementation_targets: keep CLI drawer as bottom/full overlay
use compact tabbed subpanels instead of long scroll

transfer_patterns.label_en: Run Configurations, Services, and Problems workbench
transfer_patterns.observed_strength: IntelliJ puts runnable configurations, tool windows, service state, and problem inspection close to the work surface so the user can start, inspect, and fix work without hunting through a dashboard.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: Desktop Runtime starts with an IDE-style Run Configuration toolbar and connected Services, Problems, and status-bar regions for search agent, CLI session, task pipe, workspace readiness, providers, adapters, sessions, decisions, and blockers.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자는 검색 에이전트 실행, CLI 세션, 다중 파이프, 준비 점검을 한 화면의 IDE식 실행 영역에서 바로 시작하고 막힌 이유를 즉시 본다.
implementation_targets: Run Configuration cards call real search agent, CLI session, task pipe, and readiness actions
Services list shows runtime, workspace, adapters, providers, and active sessions
Problems strip links blockers to terminal, settings, questions, or readiness checks
status bar summarizes runtime, CLI, model, sessions, inbox, and terminal state
risk_controls: readiness script requires the new workbench tokens
responsive CSS keeps the tool-window layout usable on smaller screens
button actions reuse existing runtime functions instead of mock interactions

transfer_patterns.observed_strength: The Codex app treats each task as a desktop thread with project scope, command menu, slash commands, terminal, Git/diff, worktree mode, artifacts, skills, MCP, browser, and approval controls around one work unit.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: Treat each agent run chat as a first-class workbench thread: the composer starts work, the bottom panel owns terminal output, the side/inspector area shows files, diff, artifacts, decisions, validations, and a mode selector keeps Local/Worktree/Cloud-like execution explicit.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자는 검색 에이전트나 다른 에이전트를 실행할 때 채팅, 파일, 터미널, 변경사항, 검증, 기록이 같은 작업 단위로 묶인다는 것을 바로 이해한다.
implementation_targets: every runnable agent opens as a work chat thread
slash-command suggestions in the work chat composer for status, plan, review, terminal, files, and skills
mode selector for direct workspace, isolated worktree, and future remote execution
risk_controls: approval and sandbox scope visible before privileged actions
worktree mode required before parallel repository edits

transfer_patterns.observed_strength: Claude Desktop makes local MCP capabilities easier to use by managing desktop extensions in settings, surfacing connector status from the chat composer, and making installed tools available in conversations.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: Put local tools, MCP servers, and CLI adapters behind one Settings > Capabilities surface, then expose connected capability chips and tool status directly in agent work chats instead of making users edit JSON or type shell bootstrap commands.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자는 설정에서 로컬 도구를 연결하고, 채팅창에서 어떤 도구가 붙어 있는지 확인한 뒤 바로 작업을 시작한다.
implementation_targets: Settings > Capabilities tab for MCP servers, desktop extensions, and guest CLI adapters
connector chips beside every agent chat composer
one-click install or setup guide for optional local tools
debug log and missing-capability recovery panel
risk_controls: sensitive fields use OS secure storage or redacted secret references
enterprise allowlist and disabled connector states are explicit
local MCP beta status and untrusted tool risk are visible before use

transfer_patterns.observed_strength: Useful agent products frame work as async tasks with status, follow-up, takeover, validation, branch/workspace isolation, and review.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: Represent every launched agent task as a platform-owned run record with workspace, lane, command, output, evidence, validation, handoff, and review status.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자는 터미널을 직접 붙잡고 있지 않아도 작업 상태와 결과를 앱에서 이어받는다.
risk_controls: tool permission prompts for destructive commands
human approval before public workflow side effects

transfer_patterns.label_en: Rules, memory, workflows, and skills are separate
transfer_patterns.observed_strength: Users understand configuration better when durable rules, auto memory, manual workflows, reusable skills, and agent definitions are not mixed together.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: The Settings and Agent Factory surfaces must make this taxonomy explicit and save each asset into the correct durable path.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자는 뭘 설정해야 하는지 몰라 헤매지 않고, 반복 작업을 올바른 자산으로 승격한다.
implementation_targets: one settings button with tabs for provider, workspace, rules, memory, workflows, skills, permissions
agent init wizard writes AGENTS.md/rules/skills with preview
risk_controls: never write private memories into versioned rules without explicit approval
show activation mode and scope before saving

transfer_patterns.observed_strength: The public Claw Code docs frame agent work around slash commands, team-style parallel review, persistent execution loops, skills discovery, config inspection, and CLI bootstrap/init flows.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: Expose agent commands, task pipe presets, team/review lanes, skills, and init/doctor/status actions as platform-managed command palette entries instead of hiding them in ad hoc terminal prompts.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자는 터미널 명령을 외우지 않고, 에이전트 팀 실행과 검증 루프를 앱의 명령/프리셋으로 시작한다.
implementation_targets: command palette entries for init, status, doctor, skills, and team review
task pipe lane for orchestration critique
setup guidance when claw is missing
risk_controls: license review required before any bundling

transfer_patterns.observed_strength: The Claw Code public docs keep implementation surfaces, command/tool inventories, verification commands, and parity gaps explicit so incomplete ports do not look complete.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: Keep every adapter, runtime surface, source editor capability, and generated command family tied to a manifest, parity gap, readiness test, and user-visible capability state.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자는 실제 구현된 것과 아직 계약/대기 상태인 것을 구분하고, 불완전한 기능을 완성품으로 오해하지 않는다.
implementation_targets: capability parity matrix for each CLI adapter
adapter command inventory in accumulated data
readiness guard for supported adapter list
customer-visible status labels for implemented versus integrated_contract
risk_controls: do not mark source-unverified references as copied implementation
validation must prove registry and runtime bridge agree

transfer_patterns.observed_strength: Agent tools are safer and easier to trust when pre-tool checks, permission requests, action approval, post-tool logging, and rollback points are visible.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: Add a platform permission layer before guest CLI actions and store approval, denial, checkpoint, and rollback records in the runtime data plane.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 파일 수정, 명령 실행, 브라우저 사용, 외부 도구 호출이 앱 안에서 승인되고 되돌릴 수 있다.

transfer_patterns.label_ko: 파일 탐색과 코드 편집/디프 리뷰 내장
transfer_patterns.label_en: Embedded file explorer, editor, and diff review
transfer_patterns.observed_strength: Developer desktop tools make the file system and proposed changes visible before commit or handoff.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: Use the native file workspace and Monaco/source review panes as first-class product surfaces, not a hidden monitoring detail.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자는 파일시스템을 끌어와 코드와 설정을 직접 보고, 에이전트가 바꾼 내용을 검토한다.
risk_controls: customer snapshot strips source file content

transfer_patterns.observed_strength: Specialized agents work better when they have narrow prompts, scoped tools, separate context, and clear delegation rules.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: Agent Factory creates named agents, subagents, skills, tools, prompts, validation gates, and promotion records from repeated human work.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자는 같은 지시를 반복하지 않고 목적별 에이전트를 쉽게 만들고 개선한다.

transfer_patterns.observed_strength: AI coding products gain trust when checks are explicit, repeatable, visible in PR/task lifecycle, and actionable when they fail.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: Represent lint, test, config contract, release readiness, customer bundle audit, and hallucination/security checks as run gates with evidence.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자는 에이전트가 만든 결과가 왜 통과했는지, 어디서 실패했는지, 다음 개선점이 뭔지 본다.
risk_controls: no unsupported factual claim without source
record command, exit code, and evidence target

transfer_patterns.observed_strength: Good desktop products own install, settings, diagnostics, update, data location, and local runtime boundaries instead of making users run many commands.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: The platform launches first, owns runtime data and UI authority, and invokes guest CLIs or sidecars through explicit adapters.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자는 명령어를 하나씩 몰라도 앱 설치, 데이터 경로, 진단, 업데이트, 실행을 한 곳에서 관리한다.

transfer_patterns.observed_strength: Fast launcher apps reduce friction by making commands searchable, installable, and keyboard-first.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: Expose actions such as open workspace, start agent, init rules, run validation, install adapter, and show diagnostics through a desktop command palette.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자는 메뉴를 찾아다니지 않고 지금 필요한 기능을 검색해서 실행한다.
risk_controls: missing adapters show setup guidance instead of blocking the app

transfer_patterns.observed_strength: Channel-like organization and decision queues help users separate projects, tasks, handoffs, approvals, and notifications.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: Use projects/spaces for work boundaries and a decision inbox for blocked agent questions, permission requests, merge gates, and follow-ups.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자는 여러 에이전트 작업을 채널처럼 분리하고, 답해야 할 것만 한 곳에서 처리한다.
risk_controls: client-side hiding is not treated as security

transfer_patterns.observed_strength: Tool ecosystems become safer when scopes, consent, auth, server trust, tool search, and elicitation are visible.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: The platform must manage MCP servers and CLI adapters as capability records with trust level, scope, auth status, and permission prompts.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자는 에이전트가 어떤 외부 도구와 데이터에 접근하는지 보고 제어한다.

transfer_patterns.observed_strength: Agentic systems need design-time controls for indirect prompt injection, excessive agency, external content, secrets, and high-risk tools.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: Treat untrusted files/web/docs/logs as data, keep least privilege defaults, require human approval for high-risk actions, and record every exception.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 사용자는 자동화가 편해져도 권한, 외부 입력, 비밀, 위험 명령이 무방비로 실행되지 않는다고 판단할 수 있다.

transfer_patterns.label_ko: 사용/평가 데이터 기반 학습 개선 루프
transfer_patterns.label_en: Learning loop from usage and evaluation data
transfer_patterns.observed_strength: Users trust agent platforms more when performance, outcomes, memories, decisions, and repeated failures are inspectable and improve future runs.
transfer_patterns.platform_decision: Persist task runs, decisions, evidence, work timing, evaluations, intent maps, and promotion candidates so the platform can improve agents and capabilities over time.
transfer_patterns.user_value_ko: 플랫폼은 작업을 쌓아두기만 하지 않고 반복 병목과 성공 패턴을 기능/에이전트 개선으로 되돌린다.
risk_controls: private data stays out of shared memory

transfer_patterns.title: AgentCore-style production agent blueprints
transfer_patterns.product_translation: The Agents screen exposes production blueprints for locally executed Python agents with runtime, memory, gateway/tool, and evaluation-guarded capabilities; applying a blueprint fills the Search Agent Work Chat and Agent Factory inputs, and AgentCore Quick Builder can create a native Agent Factory proposal instead of leaving the reference as documentation.
risk_controls: AWS AgentCore CLI and credentials remain optional deployment adapters
Lambda or other cloud functions may be remote tool connectors but are not the agent execution host
No AgentCore sample source code is copied into the shipped app
The desktop runtime owns local Python execution, task state, records, and UI authority
Agent proposal records are written through the app-owned native Agent Factory command
Provider direct-run and task-run persistence remain the first execution path
validation: readiness tests assert AgentCore blueprint UI tokens
service readiness checks include production blueprint surface and quick proposal creation
